claim_boundary: No fixed nonzero label-preserving diagonal map realizes the declared all-h, all-t projective equality between the complete Cycle-206 source family and the fixed C198 point. This does not reject parameter-dependent, non-diagonal, nonlinear, selected-source-point, or other source-authorized interfaces, and proves no target minor identity, AFK, fusion, Stark, or TCC statement.

companion_decision.evidence_scope_review: Corrected C209 proves nonconstant source projective variation on the admissible locus: P_(0,1)/P_(0,0)=t^4 gives 16 and 81 at t=2,3, incompatible with one fixed diagonal map to a fixed finite nonzero C198 projective point.
companion_decision.falsifier: Any admissible-domain, packet-ratio, h-independence, target nonvanishing, fixed-c, projective-ratio, t=2,3, preflight, or replay discrepancy invalidates the seal.
companion_decision.known_flaw: Uniform equality for every admissible t may be stronger than the bridge requires, and no target ratio or minor has been evaluated.
companion_decision.next_action: Derive the logarithmic projective connection forced by the packet exponents and test whether its canonical parallel transport is A6/multiplier-compatible and reaches the C198 target without selecting or fitting t.
companion_decision.reason: The corrected witnesses are in the frozen source domain and give an exact contradiction while leaving every broader interface family outside the claim boundary.
companion_decision.recommendation: Seal the corrected fixed-diagonal/all-fibre no-go and open a new cycle; a t-dependent intertwiner is a distinct method family.

fixed_diagonal_contradiction.assumed_map_family: J_c(e_(a,b))=c_(a,b)*chi_(a,b), with every c_(a,b) nonzero and independent of h,t
fixed_diagonal_contradiction.assumed_projective_equality: [c_(a,b)*P_(a,b;h)(t)]_(a,b)=[L_(a,b)]_(a,b) for every h and every admissible t>0, t!=1
fixed_diagonal_contradiction.conclusion: No fixed nonzero label-preserving diagonal J_c satisfies the declared all-h, all-t projective equality.
fixed_diagonal_contradiction.constant_requirement: The same nonzero right-hand-side constant must equal both 16 and 81.

gate_outcome.remaining_design_problem: Construct or falsify a parameter-dependent, non-diagonal, nonlinear, or differently sourced interface without endpoint fitting.

outcome.statement: No fixed nonzero label-preserving diagonal map sends every admissible source packet fibre to the one fixed finite-nonzero C198 projective point. The contradiction is t^4=16=81 at the two admissible witnesses t=2,3.
